hero.title: About This Prototype
hero.description: A technical demonstration of a modern, fast, and scalable church website architecture.

items.name: React
items.description: Provides a modular, component-based user interface that makes updating individual pieces of the site seamless and keeps the codebase incredibly organized.

items.name: Vite
items.description: A next-generation build tool that ensures highly optimized assets, keeping the final bundle size small and the page load times instant.

items.name: Tailwind CSS
items.description: A utility-first CSS framework allowing for rapid, consistent, and fully responsive styling to ensure the site looks perfect on any device.

items.name: AI-Assisted Architecture
items.description: The foundational React component structure, Tailwind CSS styling, and JSON data pipelines were pair-programmed using Google's Gemini AI. This modern workflow drastically accelerates prototyping, allowing the developer to focus on high-level architecture, user experience, and deployment strategy while maintaining clean, modular code.

items.name: Decoupled Static Data
items.description: Ministry information and schedules are separated from the layout using local JSON files. This provides maximum speed, easy version control, and zero database latency for static content.

items.name: Progressive Web App (PWA)
items.description: Configured to support PWA capabilities, allowing the site to load quickly, provide offline support, and be installed directly to a user's mobile home screen.

items.name: GitHub Pages Deployment
items.description: The entire application is built to be statically compiled and reliably deployed via GitHub Pages, minimizing infrastructure costs while maximizing uptime.
